design: native eight-group64-lane constant ROM binding; group0 unchanged physicalwrapper, groups1..7 SW8/LB8g children; exact fault first-cause aggregation

compute.operation: registered decode/select and ROM read; no numerical reordering

replica_mux_and_fanout.per_group_macro_read_select: same original two wide4-lane+one narrow8-lane row selectors and2-depth selects; no global data mux
replica_mux_and_fanout.global_read_clock_fanout: 48macros plus local stations; physical tree not yet composed
replica_mux_and_fanout.first_cause_logic: priority range1 over alignment2 over column-disagreement3 only at first global fault;2bit latch plus1seenbit; same-edge output uses combinational candidate until latched

channel_price.limitation: gross capacity only; actual pin clusters, halo, routing reach, stage and fault trees must be composed by ROMroot

latency.fault_edges_vs_original: 0 required and tested each edge by candidate combinational first-cause/held latch output
latency.prefetch_first_use_cost: not zero; local controller st_rdy guards stage start and token position; compose measured fills+far_latency
latency.steady_single_user_token_delta: pending actual ROM/cbuf placements, relay count, readiness and measured stage timing; no adoption claim

flow_control.ROM: fixed5-edge read strobes, held output when no read; no invented infinite queue
flow_control.cbuf: one fill at a time, finite f_out and banks0/1/HEAD+2rope entries; downstream binding owned by ROMroot

physical_reuse.group0: call original ot_qfd_crom_g byte-identical; closed view valid only at original executable/ABI/constraints
physical_reuse.group1_to7: native LB8g changes alignment control and mask mapping; no exact original view identity claim, no new PNR queued
physical_reuse.aggregate_fault_logic: new small block needs physical integration/closure; no in-context claim
